name: BASIO KYV32

Network.Technology: 3.9G: FDD-LTE (au VoLTE) (N800 MHz/2 GHz), 3G: W-CDMA (850 MHz/2 GHz), 2G: GSM (1.9 GHz/1.8 GHz/900 MHz)

Body.Dimensions: 142 mm H , 70 mm W , 10.4 mm D
Body.Other: 1. LTE supports carrier aggregation, 2. Charging desktop stand (cradle) included as an accessory, 3. SAR value: 0.770 W/kg (head), 0.674 W/kg (body)

Memory.Card slot: microSDHC (up to 32 GB), microSDXC (up to 128 GB) (officially supported by KDDI), *Use of microSD cards 2 GB or lower, or Class 2 or lower transfer rate cards is not recommended.

Display.Display: 5.0-inch TFT LCD, FHD (1920 × 1080 pixels), approx. 16.77 million colors

Cameras.Rear camera: Approx. 13 megapixels, CMOS image sensor with face detection autofocus
Cameras.Front camera: Approx. 970,000 pixels, CMOS image sensor (Exmor R for mobile)
